svg.title: A nurse is caring for a client who is fully dilated and pushing. The client states she feels the need to urinate. Which of the following actions should the nurse take?
svg.desc: A full bladder slows descent and raises the risk of postpartum hemorrhage and bladder trauma, so it is emptied — but by straight catheter or bedpan, not by walking a fully dilated, pushing client to the bathroom, where she may deliver and where she may not be safe to stand. The urge to push is often felt as rectal or bladder pressure, but the nurse assesses rather than dismisses it. Fluids are not withheld.
